question: What is the object-oriented systems development life cycle?

standard_rag.answer: The object-oriented software development life cycle consists of object-oriented analysis, object-oriented design, and object-oriented implementation. It is a use-case driven approach where use-case models can be employed throughout most activities of software development. (File: OOAD_CAT_I_StudyMaterial.pdf, Page: 66)
